The knowledge search found no relevant entry. I’ll compute the exact probabilities by propagating all reachable platform states; balls that roll away are excluded, while balls remaining after the ramp empties are allowed to be ejected.
The key boundary case is when the ramp is empty: empty piston positions are no-ops, so I’ll condition on the occupied positions and continue until every remaining platform ball is either ejected or released.
I’ll now run that recurrence and report the maximizing ball only.
